title: NixOS Drama Explained, a Personal Account
summary: A long personal account by a former NixOS contributor of his experience in the community, his ban and the governance events. He aims to correct what he sees as a false narrative about the NixOS drama.
why: Linked as a firsthand account of the NixOS moderation and governance disputes, from a banned member's perspective.

quote.text: For anyone looking to get a summary of the whole NixOS drama, Jon Ringer (who got permabanned) has a YouTube video
